payload.summary: Replanned the stale broad rollout into inert Gemini batch infrastructure, adapted the prior implementation to current architecture, and fixed five review findings. Focused and broad regression suites now cover durable claims, async provider correlation, bounded fallback, advisory maintenance, read-only operations, and safe defaults.
completed_work: Passed focused and broad regression tests

decisions.title: Keep rollout core-only
decisions.rationale: Current ingestion-filter and YouTube paths need workflow-specific persistence and resume designs.

decisions.title: Use internal leader election
decisions.rationale: A PostgreSQL advisory lock preserves canonical operation types while selecting one maintenance worker.
